title: Every page of the storefront
caption: The 20 HTML pages of `ota/frontend` (plus `/p/<slug>`, served by `p.html`). URLs are the file paths; ids travel in the query string. Click a page for its purpose and module.

root.name: Storefront (<key>.ota.example.com)
root.detail: One static build for every OTA; the tenant is the host.

children.name: / Home
children.detail: `index.html`, `src/pages/index.js`: the search form (one-way, return, multi-city).

children.name: /search.html Results
children.detail: `src/pages/search.js`: runs `flights.search` once, keeps `search=srch_…` in the address, filters, sort, load more.

children.name: /offer.html Offer
children.detail: `src/pages/offer.js`: one offer, fare families (upsell), prices the chosen fare.

children.name: /price.html Price
children.detail: `src/pages/price.js`: confirmed price, breakdown, extras available, fare rules, countdown, Continue to checkout.

children.name: /checkout.html Checkout data
children.detail: `src/pages/checkout.js`: travellers → contacts → extras → payment method and terms.

children.name: /checkout/pay-card.html Pay by card
children.detail: `src/pages/checkout-pay-card.js`: Stripe Payment Element, Review total, Pay. The only page with Stripe.js.

children.name: /checkout/pay-airline.html Airline card
children.detail: `src/pages/checkout-pay-airline.js`: the page's own card form, built on its own, no boot(), no third-party script.

children.name: /checkout/complete.html Complete
children.detail: `src/pages/checkout-complete.js`: Stripe's return URL; waits for the payment, calls `checkout.complete`.

children.name: /confirmation.html Confirmation
children.detail: `src/pages/confirmation.js`: booking reference, tickets, polling of the ticketing status.

children.name: /bookings.html My bookings
children.detail: `src/pages/bookings.js`: tabs upcoming / past / cancelled, signed-in customers only.

children.name: /booking.html Booking detail
children.detail: `src/pages/booking.js`: trip, tickets, documents, contact change, cancellation, history, fare rules.

children.name: /lookup.html Guest lookup
children.detail: `src/pages/lookup.js`: reference + last name, sets the guest cookie.

children.name: /account/sign-in.html
children.detail: `src/pages/account-sign-in.js`

children.name: /account/sign-up.html
children.detail: `src/pages/account-sign-up.js`

children.name: /account/verify.html
children.detail: `src/pages/account-verify.js`: the e-mailed `vt_…` token.

children.name: /account/forgot-password.html
children.detail: `src/pages/account-forgot-password.js`

children.name: /account/reset-password.html
children.detail: `src/pages/account-reset-password.js`: the e-mailed `pr_…` token.

children.name: /account/ My account
children.detail: `src/pages/account-index.js`: profile, e-mail, password, sign out everywhere, delete.

children.name: /p/<slug> Content page
children.detail: `p.html`, `src/pages/p.js`, `src/lib/blocks.js`: the OTA's pages (terms, privacy, FAQ…).

children.name: /404.html Not found
children.detail: `src/pages/404.js`: Caddy's `handle_errors 404`.
